alertPolicy.displayName: Prod Grafana dead-man: health failing for 5 minutes

documentation.content: External Grafana /api/health has failed for at least five minutes. Grafana evaluation and notifications may be unavailable; this synthetic infrastructure signal does not prove a user outage. Check GKE Grafana readiness, SQLite lock logs, PVC health and ingress before intervention. See backend/charts/monitoring/README.md. This policy runs in Cloud Monitoring, independently of Grafana.

conditions.displayName: Grafana health check failing for 5 minutes
